Title: Why Your Dark Circles Won't Fade (3 Everyday Culprits)

Description:
Getting enough sleep but those dark circles still won't fade? It might not just be sleep - a few everyday drinks and snacks could be part of the problem.

Coffee, alcohol, and salty snacks can each make the thin skin under your eyes look darker, whether through dehydration, dilated blood vessels, or fluid retention.

Watch to find out why, and simple swaps that help.
